confirmed.entrypoint: Pinned IWYU standalone CMake first enables its project, then loads LLVM and Clang CONFIG packages, AddLLVM and HandleLLVMOptions; compiler/SDK/package paths must therefore be supplied before initial configure.
confirmed.matching_packages: Explicit LLVM_DIR and Clang_DIR select only this prefix. LLVMConfig derives its prefix from its own real path. ClangConfig requires exact LLVM 21.0.0 and exports clang-cpp; CLANG_LINK_CLANG_DYLIB is ON. LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB is also ON.
confirmed.build_compiler: The admitted original LLVM configure cache is byte-identical to its recorded SHA256 and selects direct Apple CLT clang/clang++, ARM64, SDK/deployment 27.0, Release, empty C/C++ and linker overrides, LLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX=OFF and LLVM_STATIC_LINK_CXX_STDLIB=OFF.
confirmed.stdlib_semantics: HandleLLVMStdlib appends -stdlib=libc++ only when LLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX is true and supported; OFF preserves the selected compiler default. DetermineGCCCompatible recognizes AppleClang through the Clang match. Retain the admitted Apple-bootstrap default library contract; no product-private libc++ header or link flags are introduced.
confirmed.iwyu_language: IWYU target explicitly requires C++17 with extensions OFF. Building IWYU itself does not require -freflection or C++26. Later analysis of P2996 inputs is a separate parser/fixture qualification.
confirmed.llvm_compile_policy: Installed package exports assertions ON, exceptions OFF and RTTI OFF. AddLLVM applies matching -fno-exceptions/-fno-rtti for compatible compilers; HandleLLVMOptions preserves assertion-related definitions. Use exported definitions and installed generated headers; do not independently change these ABI settings.
confirmed.link_policy: IWYU_LINK_CLANG_DYLIB=ON links clang-cpp. add_llvm_executable follows imported LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB=ON through USE_SHARED. The intended runtime uses the exact fork LLVM/Clang dylibs plus the admitted Apple compiler standard-library contract.
confirmed.resource_policy: Default clang-relative mode compiles IWYU_RESOURCE_BINARY_PATH from the imported clang target. Empty IWYU_RESOURCE_DIR falls back to CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR, documented as empty for standalone builds. Keeping the qualified LLVM prefix fixed preserves that anchor when IWYU alone moves; actual runtime implementation is not present yet.
confirmed.install_policy: CMake installs the executable, fix_includes.py and iwyu_tool.py to CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR; .imp mappings to share/include-what-you-use through GNUInstallDirs and the manual to the man directory. The pinned file does not copy Clang builtin headers into the IWYU prefix.
